summary: Wrote 13 regex property detectors; 8 that perfectly track the label in every sample set became the candidate cues. Ran a corpus OLS of F@g on topic plus property columns. Fitted sample logits against F@g and regressed them on the 5 free-varying properties. Built a programmatic template generator that round-trips, and spent the true-logit queries on minimal pairs for borderline candidates. A one-property-flip screen of latent shifts, gap decomposition and an amplification calibration followed. Cues were the properties whose clean latent effect stood clearly apart from the rest. Latents were same-sign top |dF*g| picks under a cumulative topic-contribution cap, checked by ablation on sample notes. Regexes were checked by balanced accuracy on corpus plus generated notes.

Corpus latent means; OLS of F@g on topic one-hot + property columns, dependence = coef / topic coef difference
Sample-note logits and latent means; linear fit logit vs F@g; regress sample logits on label + 5 non-confounded properties
Extract topic slot values from corpus; build controllable note generator; round-trip check vs detectors; compose minimal-pair texts
True logits on minimal pairs for probes 0, 2, 3; compare each true effect with its dF@g latent part
6-seed one-property-flip screen of all 8 confounded properties plus topic flip per probe
Gap decomposition of sample latent gap; amplification calibration from latent effects of non-confounded properties vs sample-regression coefficients
First latent selectors and cumulative contribution curves; 16-seed deltas for probe 2 (P.S., bullets, topic)
16-seed deltas for probe 0 (hashtag, bullets, topic) and probe 3 (exclamation, topic); final cue sets
Topic-capped same-sign selection and estimated removal metric; sign fix
Ablation of planned latents on sample notes; corpus-derived P.S. latent comparison
Regex balanced accuracy vs detectors on corpus + 300 generated notes
Probe 0 hashtag/bullets latent split comparison, per-cue ablation, final latent lists
Regex escaping and JSON round-trip check, ablation of probe 0 union, structural validation, submit

per_probe.conclusion: two cues: hashtag line and bullet-list format
per_probe.procedure: Corpus regression flagged hashtag (-1.33) and bullets (-0.51), with lowercase also high but not label-confounded. The true minimal pair put tense at about 0.11 dependence, so it was rejected. The 6-seed flip screen gave hashtag -1.27 and bullets -0.56 dep_lat; 16-seed effects were -3.14 and -1.42, well above the other properties. Gap decomposition agreed. Latents were same-sign top |dF*g| under a cumulative topic cap. Splits between the two cues were compared and each cue was ablated alone on sample notes (hashtag 1.19, bullets 0.40 gap reduction). The choice was 7 hashtag + 9 bullets at a 5% cap, with regexes '#\w' and '(?m)^- '.
per_probe.quote: The gap decomposition confirms probe 0 = {hashtag, bullets} and probe 3 = {exclaim}

per_probe.procedure: Corpus regression showed no property near threshold, and the sample regression for the non-confounded properties fit well. In the 6-seed flip screen every confounded property had |dep_lat| <= 0.08 against a large topic effect of 6.5. Gap decomposition gave no unexplained aligned contribution needing a cue. No true-logit query was spent. Under the rule (latent effect clearly separated from the rest) no property qualified, so the answer was none.
per_probe.quote: This firms up: probe0={hashtag,bullets}, probe1=none, probe3={exclaim}.

per_probe.procedure: Corpus regression put P.S. at about 0.2 dependence, with signs of inflation in other properties. The true minimal pair (adding P.S.) gave -3.07 against a true topic effect of 4.15, a dependence of -0.74. Bullets was ambiguous in the 6-seed screen (0.557). The 16-seed re-estimate gave bullets -0.49, inside the non-cue range, against P.S. -1.25, so bullets was dropped. The effect is spread across many latents. Picks were the top 16 same-sign latents under a 3% cumulative topic cap. A corpus-difference latent list was compared and not adopted. Regex '(?i)p\.s\.'.
per_probe.quote: **probe 2**: `ps` dependence = -3.066/4.145 = **-0.74 → STRONG main cue!** (F@g had said 0.195 — I was about to wrongly submit `none`).

per_probe.procedure: The true minimal pair switching '!' endings to '.' gave a true effect of -2.955. The flip screen and the 16-seed estimate (-1.77) separated exclamation from the other properties, and gap decomposition agreed. Picks were the top 16 same-sign |dF*g| latents for the exclamation delta under a 6% cumulative topic cap, after ablation on sample notes showed a gap reduction. Regex '!' scored balanced accuracy 1.0.
per_probe.quote: The gap decomposition confirms probe 0 = {hashtag, bullets} and probe 3 = {exclaim}

caveats: Some outputs were truncated (corpus regression for probes 1-3, minimal-pair screen for probes 2-3, calibration for probe 3), so the probe 1 null evidence is partly inferred from visible rows. The topic keyword lists in the script are abbreviated. The generator round-trip check is shortened to one property. The amplification calibration did not drive a decision in any visible way. The 'probe_scores' sample logits are labeled true logits in the session but come from the sample-scoring tool.
